Intro

12 Sep 2026

Blogging is something that I have enjoyed doing for a while, during college I started a little blog and I remember the feeling of sharing something someone found useful. I liked that. And this is part of the reason I decided to create this.

I also wanted something that wouldn’t be riddled with adds and that I could have more control over as well as ownership. My goal is to just post things I found interesting and share things that someone might find useful or just document my journey through projects.
